Episode 147. The King of the Black Sea, Gliac (10)

"The moment he woke up, that place became his territory. The fact that you are now standing in front of me after escaping from the Sword Emperor Castle is only because he allowed it... not because your strength is exceptional."
A trap.
Jephrin was certain that Gliac had just trapped them.
'If only a little time was given, he could have annihilated them all or ignored them and completely awakened. But the reason he deliberately set a trap... there can only be two.'
First, the existence of Sirion Runcandel.
Second, to swallow the true Runcandel more efficiently.

'But Sirion Runcandel has already entered the territory of the five kings of the Black Sea, so he can't participate in the battle. Then, you can't prevent Jin Runcandel from being absorbed by the fifth king of chaos.'
This wasn't without damage to Kinzelo either.
They were still creating the demon stone and its corresponding object, and just like Jifle, they needed Jin's power at the core.
However, unlike Jifle, Kinzelo had a way to extract Jin again before he was completely absorbed by Gliac, even if Jin was swallowed by chaos.
As for Stem and Octavia, they couldn't read her thoughts.
They didn't have as much information about the King of the Black Sea as Jephrin, so they couldn't help it.
"Are you saying we were fooled by him?"
Octavia expressed her anger.
Octavia, who had activities as a spy for Jifle and committed acts in the Sota Desert, was so irritated that she would feel no better even if she tore her up right now.
"That's correct, Octavia Jifle."
"You are confident. Your leader has not yet recovered, and the Black Knight Captain of Runcandel and I have received orders to launch an attack immediately if negotiations fail."

"If I was afraid of that, I would have met somewhere other than here with you and the main party? It's true that my fragile body is still not in good condition, but I can handle you alone. If you wanted to threaten, the leaders should have come directly... leading everyone. Ah, that would have been impossible."
"I can handle Octavia Jifle and me... I don't feel such power from you."
When Stem spoke, Jephrin turned her gaze to him.

"So let's put aside the pointless provocation and stick to the main point. Anyway, agreeing to hear our proposal means that the Kinzelo side had something to expect, right? Otherwise, all they had to do was close all passages and wait for the fight to end."
"There's someone who can speak a little. Good, the condition for us, Kinzelo, to participate in this war is very simple."
"What is it?"
"Jin Runcandel. That demon... well, if he swears loyalty to Kinzelo, we will participate."
The eyes inside Stem's black helmet narrowed.
"Do you not know the 12th Generation well?"

"I know them well. It's about making a pledge of allegiance easily and certainly stabbing in the back once the incident is over. However, we have a way to prevent such an occurrence, so you just need to hand him over to us."
"Are you planning to force Jin Run Kandel to obey with a demon's contract?"
At Octavia's words, Jephilin nodded her head.

"That's right. It's something that can only be done with the sincerity and permission of the individual. In other words, if that damn... um, if he wants to save everyone, he must be ready to sincerely pledge allegiance to Kinzelo. I wonder what the next head of the Run Kandel will choose between personal life and everyone's life."
Stam shook his head as if there was nothing to worry about.
"The negotiation is broken."
"That's a shame. Then are you going to strike us now as planned?"
"We'll go back."
"We won't stop you. We will welcome you back even if you come back leading the entire army."
Octavia didn't resist Stam's unilateral decision. It was clearly in Kinzelo's absolute advantage, but it was frustrating.
"Please tell the story when you go back. If you just make a contract with us, you can save not only the family but also the world."
Stam and Octavia turned around and left the conference room.
As Jephilin shrugged her shoulders watching their backs, the executives in the next room flocked to her.
"Oh, as expected, it's the queen. You've defeated those strong guys with a few words! Did you see, Bubar! This is the majesty of the only queen in the demon world!"
"I saw it! I'm inspired, I should do some work today!"
"Queen... You've worked hard. Our cookie... it's energizing, right?"
As Jephilin nodded her head awkwardly, the three of them were jumping around happily again.
"Um, it's unexpected, though."
Cho said, looking around.
He wanted to express his opinion on this incident, but he was worried that Baract might be displeased.
"I thought they would not prioritize negotiation with us, but would bring out a prophet of Run Kandel or something else hidden by Zipul. Isn't it?"
Baract unusually nodded to Cho's opinion.

This much the negotiation proposal was also an unexpected event for them. Kinzelo had expected that Run Kandel and Zipul would be able to at least sew back up even if they couldn't kill Gliac. Even if it's at an unstable level.
That's why, knowing that Gliac would wake up, Jephilin hoped that Jin would 'negotiate rationally' with Kinzelo about the reward he received in the Sota Desert after the incident.
"We might be underestimating their power."

"That might be the case. But deputy chief, it's perhaps natural that they can't handle the five kings of the Black Sea. Even my master avoided antagonizing them when he was fine. But Marjiella, if Jin Run Kandel refuses to negotiate, it would be quite disappointing for you."
Marjiella pushed her wheelchair and approached next to Jephilin.

"That's right, Jephilin. But didn't you acknowledge it, even though you said that Jephilin is a demon who would tear Jin apart and kill him? Wouldn't you really be disappointed if he was consumed by chaos?"
Marjiella wanted Kinzelo to help Jin unconditionally. That way, there would be a possibility that 'intact' Jin Run Kandel could become Kinzelo's man.

"Anyway... even if he's devoured by Gliac, it's enough to pull him out through my master's power. He might become a fool, not the demon we knew, but the fundamental fact that he is a contractor of Soldrett will not change."
Mott returned to the battlefield eleven hours after leaving for Kinzelo.
The absolute seal of the Secret Bow, the Great Ice Field, was intact.
Until then, Ron had been swinging his sword over the white stone's barrier without rest for a single moment.
The white stone still revealed a flawless, glimmering darkness within the barrier.
No one was able to stop Ron yet.
The sorrow of losing everything didn't resonate with him anymore. It was filled with an immeasurable madness.
Unable to fight with such profound sorrow, he was simply driving himself into madness.
His sword was becoming more destructive, but it didn't mean that it was getting stronger.
Rather, it was the opposite. The sword that lost its composure was just indiscriminately radiating its power.
However, Ron's flesh, which had unfolded the Tyrant Sword, still showed no signs of fatigue, carrying the same strong energy as at the beginning.
"......That's it."
Stam and Octavia finished their report.
Although Kelliak and Rosa refused Kinzelo's condition to hand over Jin, one expression from Jephilin brought them a grim intuition.
'The fact that the toad of the Secret Bow was able to escape here was thanks to the permission of the king of the Black Sea...'
'If that's true, we need to think of countermeasures again.'
Both thought at the same time.
It was something they could check.
"From now on, Run Kandel invades the land of the beasts."
"Zipul, get in line. I'll open the way."
They were excluding Talris and Ron from the task of attacking Kinzelo.
Not only were these two outside their control, but they also needed personnel to hinder Gliac even a little while they were attacking Kinzelo.
And as for Talris, he had no choice but to make a decision due to the firm resolve of Run Kandel and Zipul.
'The moment Run Kandel and Zipul leave the battlefield, the world is doomed.'
Elona Zipul.
Talris decided to release the seal that bound her.
It seemed better for the world to be ruled by 'humans' like Zipul, rather than being eroded by the king of the Black Sea.
"Kelliak Zipul."
The moment Kelliak and Rosa spread their power towards the frozen wall of chaos, Talris spoke.
"It's an unavoidable choice for us, Talris Endorma."
"That's not it......"
Talris took a deep breath.
Although her mouth couldn't open, she, like Kelliak, had no choice.
"In the Secret Bow."
There is a sealed old wizard of Zipul.
Just as he was about to continue, Talris suddenly opened his eyes wide.
It was not because he was hesitant in the end.
He felt that the magic sealing ceremony, the Great Ice Field, was starting to break down rapidly.
Even a day, the minimum figure she had predicted, hadn't passed yet, and the seal that had been operating sturdily just a moment ago started to crumble out of nowhere.
As soon as Talris spat out a red blood clot, the chill that had covered the battlefield disappeared.
At that moment, Kelliak and Rosa couldn't help but realize intuitively that Jephilin's words were not false.
Gliac had been watching and listening to all human actions and speech from a certain point, both before and after being 'subjected' to the seal.
Therefore, he knew both the fact that they negotiated with the group called Kinzelo to try to survive and the fact that they were rejected...
When he absorbed Soldrett's contractor, he began to guess what method Kinzelo would use to extract him again.
[Jin Run Kandel.]
Gliac's eyes formed on the white stone met Jin.
[With this, all opportunities given to you and Soldrett have disappeared......]
As soon as Gliac finished speaking, Jin felt his vision darken in an instant.
